import itertools
i,o=G['Demo pair 1 input'],G['Demo pair 1 output']
h,w=13,14
def g(A,r,c): return A[r][c] if 0<=r<h and 0<=c<w else None
changed={(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if i[r][c]!=o[r][c]}
# candidate predicates on input neighborhood
preds={}
def mk(name,f): preds[name]=f
mk('vdiff', lambda r,c: g(i,r-1,c)!=g(i,r+1,c))
mk('hdiff', lambda r,c: g(i,r,c-1)!=g(i,r,c+1))
mk('ddiff1', lambda r,c: g(i,r-1,c-1)!=g(i,r+1,c+1))
mk('ddiff2', lambda r,c: g(i,r-1,c+1)!=g(i,r+1,c-1))
mk('above0', lambda r,c: g(i,r-1,c)==0)
mk('below0', lambda r,c: g(i,r+1,c)==0)
mk('left0', lambda r,c: g(i,r,c-1)==0)
mk('right0', lambda r,c: g(i,r,c+1)==0)
mk('diagboth0', lambda r,c: g(i,r-1,c-1)==0 or g(i,r+1,c-1)==0)
mk('above_eq_left', lambda r,c: g(i,r-1,c)==g(i,r,c-1))
for name,f in preds.items():
    ok=all(f(r,c)==((r,c) in changed) for r in range(h) for c in range(w))
    if ok: print('MATCH',name)

def transform(g):
    g=[list(r) for r in g]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    blocks=[] # each block: list of column-pairs (col_a, col_b), last block may be width2
    ncol=w
    starts=[k for k in range(0,ncol) if g[0][k]!=0 and (k==0 or g[0][k-1]==0)]
    # build blocks: separator zero columns; find zero columns in row0
    zc=[j for j in range(ncol) if all(g[r][j]==0 for r in range(h))]
    # blocks are maximal runs between zero cols
    blocks=[]; s=0
    for z in zc+[ncol]:
        blocks.append(list(range(s,z))); s=z+1
    def zcount(cols):
        return sum(1 for r in range(h) for c in cols if g[r][c]==0)
    order=sorted(range(len(blocks)), key=lambda k:(-zcount(blocks[k]), k))
    out=[[0]*ncol for _ in range(h)]
    pos=0
    for k in order:
        for c in blocks[k]:
            for r in range(h): out[r][pos]=g[r][c]
            pos+=1
        if pos<ncol: pos+=1  # skip separator zero column
    return out
